tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mgon po dkar po yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga yongs 'du sa brtol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// swasti siddhi rastu/ bla ma mchog dang tha dad min pa'i lha// phul byung bsod nams mgron du khugs pa dang*// lhan cig srid las 'das dang srid pa'i dpal// dar bab 'dod pa 'jo der phyag 'tshal nas// thugs rje dpag yas mgon po spyan ras gzigs// mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam skong byed pa'i// cho ga yongs 'du sa brtol dbang po 'das// grub pa zung gi snye ma ci yang ster// gang zhig dgyes pa'i 'dzum zer grol tsam gyis// ji ltar mngon 'dod re ba yongs skong bas// slad du phongs pa'i gdung skyob phal dag la// kha gsags lag pa rkyong ba'i gus pa skyungs// de la sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes// sbyor ba sku rten rab gnas can// de mdun 'di yi dpal gtor ram// yang na zlum gtor mtheb kyu can// g.yas su mkha' 'gro g.yon gzhi bdag /rgyab tu gnod sbyin gtor mas bskor// mdun du bskang gtor zlum po dkar// sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes pa dang*// nyer spyod bskang rdzas spyan gzigs bsham// dngos gzhi bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod// sngags bzlas gsol gdab bskang ba'i rim// rjes ni bstod gsol brtan bzhugs dang*// bkra shis bsngo bas mtha' brgyan no// zhes pa ltar las/ dngos gzhi'i dang po gnas dang yo byad byin rlabs chu gnyis min pa kye rdor ltar byas nas bdag bskyed ni/ sgrub thabs khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes pa kho bos byas pa ltar na/ nye bar bsdu ba'i rjes nas rang lha'i skur ldang ba'i bar ram/ de min yang gzhan gang mos kyi steng nas nyams su blang*/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed la thog mar gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis bran la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/

raṃ las me dang*/ mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ bhrūm̐ ām̐ dzrīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga rnams mes gdungs te bskol zhing zhu bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi rten bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dngul chu dwangs pa'i mdog lta bu/ de yongs su gyur pa las padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu sogs nas thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba/ 'khor du mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin nor bdag gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dur khrod bsil ba tshal nas/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin nor bdag gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pas mgon po 'khor bcas ḍā ma ru'i sgra dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sil sgra dang bcas te mdun gyi nam mkha'i ngos thams cad khyab par 'byon par bsams la/ rnga rol lam mi nus na dril gsil dang bcas te/ hūm̐ tsandan ljon shing mtshan pa'i dur khrod nas// ston ka'i sprin dkar phung po g.yo ba bzhin// phyag na padma'i rnam rol bstan srung mchog /mgon dkar nor bu'i char 'bebs gnas 'dir gshegs// lha chen bla ma yid bzhin nor bu yi// bka' sgrub phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dbang du sdud// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dngos grub myur stsol ba// mkha' 'gro nor bdag tshogs bcas da tshur spyon// mgon po 'khor bcas sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang*// dam tshig la dgongs dgyes pas gnas 'di ru// nor bu dgos 'dod dpal dang 'grogs pa bzhin// tshur gshegs dpal 'byor rnam par rgyas par mdzod// ces dang*/

oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi zhes dang*/ dzaḥnyer gcig gis spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ de nas gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod don gsol ba 'debs pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ gzhan thams cad mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar phul bas 'thus so// gsum pa bzlas pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed 'khor bcas kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ srid zhi'i dge legs dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus nas dngos grub tu stsol bar bsams la/ sngags ci rigs bzlas la 'dod don gsol ba gdab bo// bzhi pa bskang ba'i rim pa la/ bskang rdzas rnams sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab cing spel ba dang bden pa'i stobs brjod la gtor sngags lan gsum la sogs pas bskang gtor bsngos la/ hūm̐ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i chu gter las// dran pa tsam nas sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor rnams// lag rtser stsol ba'i mgon po yid bzhin dbang*// 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas 'bul ba ni// gnam sngon zhun ma 'khyil 'dra'i khyon yangs par// nor bu'i ka gdung grangs med kyis bteg pa// ba gam rtsig logs yangs par snang srid kyi// gzugs brnyan mig gi dga' ston yongs bkra ba// rgya phibs nor bu'i tog gi 'od zer gyi// lag pa stong gi mkha' la 'khyud pa snyam// drwa ba dril chung grangs med 'thab pa'i dbyangs// rna ba'i dpyid du chos kyi glur 'jo bas// mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'khor bcas kyi// thugs dam bskang ngo dbang rgyas dngos grub stsol// mchod yon rgya mtsho 'khyil pa'i dba' rlabs khrod// lbu dkar ngang mo bye ba'i zlos gar bsgyur// thang chur skyes pa'i 'dab stong dga' tshal brgya// rkang drug dga' ba'i drug 'gyur glu yang len// dri zhim spos mchog nam mkha'i glang po dag /zhing kun khyab par nyul ba'i gom stabs bsgyur// rin chen 'bru mar mar me'i phreng bstar la// phrag dog khros pa'i mun pa rgyang ring song*// reg na sim pa'i bde ster dri chab rdzing*// ku sha'i rnga yab stong gis 'thungs shing 'thor// ro mchog zhal zas 'bigs byed ri bo dang*// mnyam yang gcig dang du ma'i khyad par che// 'chi med sgra snyan 'bum phrag pham byed pa'i// bstod dbyangs rol mo snyan pa'i glur len pas// mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'khor bcas kyi// thugs dam bskang ngo dbang rgyas dngos grub stsol// gser gyi sa gzhir 'khyil ba'i chu gter klong*// rin chen lhun po lha gnas bye bas mdzes// ri bdun bcu gnyis gling gis yongs bskor ba// khor yug nyi zla'i 'od gsal bye ba brgya// de der 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid bdun// gang bsams lhun grub nye ba'i rin chen bdun// 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bum bzang dpag bsam shing*// 'dod 'jo bzhon ma'i rnam pa bgrang du med// ma rmos rmos pa'i lo thog 'bru yi rigs// nad 'joms sman dang 'chi med bcud kyis len// stong ku'i yul gyi e rdo da ka'i phon// lo mar bcas pa'i la phug la du sogs// ro drug bcud ldan bza' ba gya nom dang*// sna tshogs rgyan gos bcas pas bkang ba 'dis// mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'khor bcas kyi// thugs dam bskang ngo dbang rgyas dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ gsang chen grub pa'i dpa' bos thabs mkhas kyi// go cha legs bgos shes rab ral gri gdengs// phyi nang gsang ba'i bdud dgra skye med dbyings// yongs bsgral khrag zhag arghaṃ mtsho ltar 'khyil// dbang po lnga yi me tog grangs med bstar// gsur chen spos kyi na bun 'khrigs shing 'khor// zhun chen sgron ma gdug pa'i lce zhags rkyong*// mkhris pa'i dri chab gser gyi lbu ba 'grems// sha rus zhal zas byi ru'i lhun po mnyam// rkang gling thod rnga sgra chen ldir ba 'dis// mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'khor bcas kyi// thugs dam bskang ngo dbang rgyas dngos grub stsol// chu gter bsrubs pa'i ngal brgyas ma mnar zhing*// sngon gyi lha las brkus pa'i sdig med par// lang tsho tshe yi bcud len bla na med// zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang*// 'chi med yul gyi yid 'phrog me na kas// legs bris bdag po'i gnas su rnam 'khrul te// dri ro nus pa phun tshogs lha yi zas// 'di na yongs su spungs snyam ba lintas// mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'khor bcas kyi// thugs dam bskang ngo dbang rgyas dngos grub stsol// skyon drug gcod dang dug gsum 'bigs pa'i phyir// reg pa gcod pa'i gri gug tri shū la// 'jig rten ye shes 'gro ba dbang sdud phyir// rdo rje lcags kyu snyan pa'i cang te'u// phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir// yid bzhin nor bu gter bum ka pā la// rin chen rgyan drug dar gyi lhab lhub sogs// zhi drag rgyan gyi rnam pa dpag med dang*// rta mchog stong gi gom stabs rlung la rtse// g.yag lug grangs med rdo rje'i rwa rtse brdar// bya rigs lding zhing gcan gzan mdur mo nyul// bstan srung mgon por 'os pa'i mthun rdzas 'dis// mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs dam bskang*// bla ma mgon po dbyer med thugs dam bskang*// khams gsum dbang sdud mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// ye shes 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// nor bdag gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs rnams kyi// thugs dam bskang ngo dbang rgyas dngos grub stsol// nyes pa bshags pa ni/

hūm̐ dran pa tsam gyis sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri// sbyong byed thugs rje'i gaṅgā 'bebs mkhas pa// dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam thugs rje can// mkha' 'gro dam tshig can rnams bdag la dgongs// rang bzhin dge ba'i sems kyi bde 'byung ni// chos 'dul bstan pa'i gangs rir gnas bcas kyang*// nyon mongs mda' lngas bsnun par ma shes par// bslab gzhi'i g.yar dam dral ba mthol lo bshags// rgyal sras 'chi med gtso bo'i gnas brnyes kyang*// bzod dang brtson 'grus snying stobs brling min pas// zhe sdang mig nas spros pa'i me dpung gis// byang sdom gzhan lus bsregs pa mthol lo bshags// smin grol thabs kyi gaṅgā gtsug 'khyil yang*// cir snang dag pa'i bdud rtsi rgyang bskyur bas// rtsa ltung ha la nag pos mgrin par 'khyud// 'khrul snang ral pas bklubs pa mthol lo bshags// grub dbang thugs kyi chu gter bsrubs pa'i bcud// bla ma mgon po zung 'jug zla ba dkar// dngos grub ga pur zegs ma 'bum 'dzag pa// bsnyen sgrub ral pa'i rtse mor mnga' gsol yang*// phyogs lhung theg dman sems kyis lha srung bsten// sgom bzlas rnam g.yeng mchod rdzas ma tshang dang*// 'bags btsog la sogs thugs dang 'gal gyur pa// thugs rje chen por mthol bshags tshangs par stsol// phrin las zhu ba ni/ hūm̐ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rim byon gyis// bka' lung gnyen po'i 'phrin yig snying ga la// 'gog med bkrag tu che ltar mdo sngags kyi// chos mig dri med ring du gsal bar mdzod// zas gtsang sras dang bzhed gcig smra ba'i mgrin// zur phud lnga pas gzengs bstod sa skya pa'i// lugs mchog bshad sgrub dri med gangs can ljongs// nyi gzhon 'od ltar ches cher gsal bar mdzod// de tshul 'doms pa'i rgyal po e waṃ pa'i// legs gsungs slob pa'i khrims ldan padma'i tshal// blo gros 'dab brgya grol ba grangs med kyis// dbyig 'dzin dkyil 'khor kun tu mdzes par mdzod// phun tshogs stobs 'byor cher grags skye bo rnams// bstan pa'i sri zhur gus par dbang bsdus nas// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis mdun bdar ba'i// ma lus rgyal ba'i myu gur bskyed bsring mdzod// bdag cag sbyin bdag 'khor du bcas pa yi// 'chi med tshe dang bsod nams rnam 'byed blo// chos nor 'dod pa thar pa'i sde tshogs rnams// phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du rgyas par mdzod// rtsi shing lo tog tshong spogs mi dang phyugs// 'phel rgyas rlabs kyis srid pa'i mtsho mdzes shing*// klog dang spong ba mkhas tshul gsum gyi 'od// dkar pos thar pa'i zla gzhon mdzes par mdzod// mi dang mi min dgra bgegs mi srun pas// chur gtad sa la mnan dang zor du rbad// hom du bsregs sogs brtsams pa'i 'bras bu rnams// byad ma rang thog bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol// 'jig rten bde legs sī ta 'phrog byed pa'i// nad mtshon mu ge dus min 'chi ba sogs// skal ngan 'bod sgrogs gzugs brgya mthar byed pa'i// mthu stobs mda' gzhu'i drag sbyor rtsoms shig kye// mdor na rnam bzhi'i phrin las 'khor lo yis// bstan 'gro'i ri gling mtha' dag dbang sgyur nas// mthar thug rnam mkhyen dbang po'i rgyal srid che// rang gzhan yongs kyis thob pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces brjod do// rjes bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa ni/

khyung pos mdzad pa'i bstod pa rgyas pa'am/ de mi nus na/ gangs can ri pa'i lha gcig pad dkar 'chang*// thugs bskyed gzhan dbang gyur pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar// skal dman sems can re ba yongs skong ba// mgon po zla ba'i spun zla la phyag 'tshal// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis dgongs gcig tu// dbang rgyas phrin las lhun grub 'khor los sgyur// spyi bor dbang bskur bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// mdzes kyi padma rā ga'i cod paṇa min// smin legs spyan gyis zur mda' 'phangs tsam gyis// skye dgu'i yid kyi brtan pa rang dbang du// 'gugs byed dga' ma thugs kar sbas pa la// nor sbyin grangs med kyis btud blta ba snyam// 'di na dkon mchog mchod pa rgyas phyir dang*// chos kyi bshad sgrub dri med ring gnas phyir// ngur smrig 'chang ba grangs med bsdu phyir dang*// chos ldan sbyin bdag mnga' thang rgyas phyir dang*// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa rdzogs bya'i phyir// mgon po yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje can// mkha' 'gro nor sbyin lha yi tshogs dang bcas// bdag cag gus pas bsgrubs kyin mchod byas pas// sgrub po yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi// tshe dang bsod nams rigs bzang yon tan dang*// stobs 'byor mnga' thang snyan par grags pa'i dbyangs// rin chen 'bru nor lha mi'i longs spyod dpal// phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus pa// dbyar gyi dpal mo dang 'grogs chu gter gyi// ngo mtshar ji bzhin gong nas gong 'phel du// rnam par rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// rigs dang stobs dang 'byor pas mngon rgyags pa'i// skye 'gro'i snying gi brtan pa rab phrogs nas// khab len mthong ba'i lcags phye ji bzhin du// 'di na 'dun pa dbang gi dngos grub stsol// zhes pas bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo// yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing*/

brtan bzhugs sogs dang bkra shis bka' rgya ma'am/ mi shes na gang rigs brjod cing me tog gi sil mas gtor ro// 'dir smras pa/ yongs 'dzin mchog gi drin gyis gdams pa mchog /bdag cag skal ba dman min snod stsal ba// de nyid nas bzung snying po mchog bar du// dpal kun 'byung ba'i ma mar bskrun par snyam// ngal brgyas bsgrubs kyang tshe 'di'i lto gos tsam// 'byung min 'phyang mo nyug dag lhur byed na// mthong chos slad mar bcas pa'i srid zhi'i dpal// 'byung ba yid ches tshul la mi 'bad ci// rnam dkar dge ba ma 'dris 'gro ba'i mdza'// sdang ba med par nyon mongs tshogs la 'thab// chags pas dben yang gdul bya thar pa cher// 'khrid byed rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgyas phyir bsngo// zhes mgon po dkar po yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs dam skong ba'i cho ga yongs 'du sa brtol zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mkhas btsun bla ma dam pa bsod nams dbang phyug pa dang chos kyi rje bkra shis dpal bzang pa dang nyer gnas kun dga' bsam gtan sogs kyis sngon du bskul ba dang*/ nye char dge slong kun dga' mchog ldan dang kun dga' stobs ldan dag gis kyang bskul bar brten/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i na tshod ldan gyi lor/ ldan yul chos sde'i gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba'i nye logs dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par sbyar ba dge legs kyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
